list_sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no separate task to do for it. Earn every other trophy in the list and it unlocks on its own. Plan for roughly 200 hours in total: the long pole is the gold trophy for 100% completion, then the big count trophies for stunts, WAiNK scans and challenges. Nothing here needs online play or downloadable content.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed; it pops the moment the last of the other 54 trophies is earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it. This is the first main mission of the game, so it comes to you naturally and cannot be skipped past. Once the mission ends, the trophy pops.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission; it unlocks by playing. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks as the chapter closes and the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole game that might be missable: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter; it unlocks by playing. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes and Chapter 3 opens. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which is when most partner trophies become possible.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter; it unlocks by playing. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 3's main missions. The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends and Chapter 4 begins. During this chapter you pick up the Key Cloner in the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which later gates several robbery and vehicle trophies, so do not rush past the story jobs.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter; it unlocks by playing. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete every main mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 is also where the big bank vault robberies open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, so take those jobs as they appear.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter; it unlocks by playing. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. The trophy is gold and pops when the credits roll. After the story you return to free roam with the 100% completion checklist unlocked under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, so the finale is the starting line for cleanup, not the end of the platinum run.
trophies.missable_note: Story finale; it unlocks by playing. Make a manual save before the final mission, since there is no mission replay and free roam continues after it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is part of the story path, so it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 2; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is on the story path, so just keep working through the Chapter 3 missions and the trophy pops when the heist is done.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 3; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It is a story mission, so it pops as you play through Chapter 4 in order.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 4; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Like the other mission trophies, it comes automatically from following the story.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 4; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is on the story path and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 4; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late story mission, so it arrives naturally near the end of the story.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission in Chapter 5; it unlocks by playing.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy and the longest job in the game. After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to see the checklist. The good news is the thresholds are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, with most side quests not required at all. You need partial counts of most things (200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts), but a few things in full: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, so scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and do optional missions when they appear — you need any 100 of them. Expect this step alone to take around 100 hours.
trophies.missable_note: Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything on the checklist can still be done in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute, and you can mix them however you like. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track your total in Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find individual spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. Note that 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; stunts stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the 9 activity types the game counts: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. You can see the list under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, and the map filter for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will almost certainly finish this by accident while working on the other trophies, so do not chase it early.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; every activity type stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges and 42 gold medals to earn across them. Visit a range, pick a challenge and beat its gold score; repeat at every range until all 42 are gold. The challenges are not very hard, and playing them also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Your progress is tracked per range in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; ranges stay open after the story.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them. Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations. Drone races are also needed in full for 100% completion, so this trophy comes naturally from that work.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; drone races stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each location only counts once, so you need wins at 20 separate spots rather than 20 wins at the same one. Races unlock as you explore, and the map marks them; pick the shorter ones and a fast car you are comfortable with.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; races stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing itself is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Cal's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it, so pick whichever you find easiest.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the home TV games and arcade machines stay playable after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Lucia only for this one. Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3, and while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy followed by a text with her home address in Belville. Work through her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. All of her quests stay available after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Andy's quests stay available after the story. Check before you finish the story only in the sense that some quest givers go quiet for a stretch mid-story and return later.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dive for the treasure with a metal detector and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets of quests — after the first set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch in the story but returns in Chapters 2 to 3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian can speed up his text), and everything stays available after the story. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Kenton returns later in the story and his quests stay open after it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Billy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers and Freaks mission strands found out in the open world. Not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street races and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (plane recovery and package deliveries). More strangers are still being found, and they all stay available after the story. Check your count in the trophy tracker.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Strangers and Freaks stay in the world after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon in west Vice City). He marks some cars on the map, and you can also steal them off the street — scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on his list. Deliver each car in good condition for more money. The list includes the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. It all stays doable after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Randy's wish list stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play as Jason for this one. Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Tyrone's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as two meditations per location. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony at Jason's house, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds 1 to your counter but is not marked as a regular meditation spot, and it is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends. It is still unconfirmed whether it is strictly required for the trophy, but the safe move is to do it and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. You cannot finish the last meditation until both characters can play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. For 100% completion you only need 15 of 18 meditations.
trophies.missable_note: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only one: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, and vanishes when the chapter ends. Do it before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play as Jason for this one. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts Jason about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message). Meet Bret, then he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. In his first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can retrieve from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps the animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy should come naturally. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Bret's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Find and complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida. Cards are a collectible type tracked in the Progress database, so work through the set locations in order and finish three full sets. You do not need all 18 sets for this trophy.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; card sets stay collectible in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 scannable spots in the world. Hold up to open WAiNK, then hold R1 on a landmark, curiosity or sculpture to scan it. There are far more than 100 in total (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more), so any 100 will do. Scan things as you travel rather than hunting them all at once, and this finishes on its own.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; WAiNK spots stay scannable after the story.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in the game, in 8 categories of 10, and you only need any 50 for this trophy. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest remaining ones. Note that 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; challenges stay completable after the story.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need both characters together, so this only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner by holding right and pressing triangle, then cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level. To escape, take a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic out of the search area; if a helicopter is on you, shoot it down. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone. You will probably also get this automatically during the bank vault robberies in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; wanted levels can be raised and escaped any time after Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you (available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the police between shops. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, and ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, the chain may not count, so let the wanted level build first.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; shops can be robbed again any time after Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app. Open WAiNK from your phone (hold up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — you do not need to drive it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The game has 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. You need 200 of the 277 base models scanned for 100% completion, so this trophy pops on the way. Check your counts under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; vehicles keep appearing in traffic after the story.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must drop 5 enemies in one use. First build your focus up — eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the slow time (hold L1, press triangle). Line up 5 enemies before you trigger it; gang operations are a good place to find a group. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 this gets much easier, and it may pop naturally late in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; Combat Focus can be attempted any time once unlocked.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door straight into it. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The trophy is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the airport and its docked planes stay accessible after the story.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the air base and its tanks stay there after the story.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with a green icon on the map. Pick a store and go in through the back door using the Snap Gun — the prompt offers kicking the door (which sets off the alarm) or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City. If an alarm goes off or anyone spots you, leave and try another store.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; jewelry stores can be robbed again after the story.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress. In it you tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner to carry a second bag (hold right to hand one off). After that, pay Yasmani the fence for tips about security vans ($10,000 a tip, after his earlier Payday Loans jobs) and he marks vans with a purple icon; follow each one to its bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to shake recognition. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need any 5 here, but 100% completion needs all 8, so this pops on the way. A single bank can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; bank vaults stay robbable after the story. Check before you finish the story: the intro mission is optional, so do it when it appears in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat radius, so get clear of the police or use a Pay 'n' Spray first.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; armored trucks keep driving around Vice City after the story.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. Any area you have never visited stays fogged, so sweep the edges of the map and the islands too. This also helps every other exploration trophy, since unfogging reveals activity and collectible icons.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the map can be unfogged any time in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need to rob one operation belonging to each gang, but 100% completion needs all 39, so it pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your count per gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; gang operations stay robbable after the story.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact unlock method is not confirmed yet by the published guides. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the working lead is to visit a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and order a drink where the view is part of the scene. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so treat any method you see online as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it — and do not let it block your run, since it is a one-off moment trophy rather than a grind. Check the PowerPyx guide for updates as launch-week guides are revised.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed — check before you finish the story: if it turns out to be tied to a one-time scene, a manual save before story moments on Ocean Beach is the safe habit.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — hack into the car, drive forward and smash out through the glass. The trophy pops a little after you drive away on the street, so keep going. It only works with this specific blue Banshee, not any other car — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the showroom and the Banshee stay there after the story. Needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3 first.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway office by blowing it with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. You do not need all three in one visit: if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can return for the rest.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; the bowling alley robbery respawns, so valuables can be collected across visits.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner along (hold right and press triangle to call them), because while one character trains, the other trains too, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; strength can be raised any time after Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile on) so you see the small demon face on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Actions fall into bands from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence) through Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them) and Violent (killing enemies and civilians) to Psycho (large-scale killing, driving over gravestones) and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid piling up so much violence that you land there, since police then shoot on sight far more often. This builds passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so it should pop while you work on the other trophies. If it is your last one, the fastest farm is running over civilians and police with a car.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; profile actions can be done any time. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile, which makes police far more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: This trophy's exact unlock method is not confirmed yet by the published guides. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — the hint being that it takes a second attempt at something there. Treat that as an unconfirmed lead, not a fact: check the PowerPyx guide for updates before spending time on it, and keep a manual save around prologue Payday Loans visits in case the trigger is a one-time interaction.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed — check before you finish the story: the believed lead involves the prologue Payday Loans store, so keep a save from early in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: This trophy's exact unlock method is not confirmed yet by the published guides. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. That means there is likely a strange encounter or side quest to find out in the world, but no verified steps exist yet at launch. Do not chase rumored UFO spots as fact — check the PowerPyx guide for updates as players pin the trigger down.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed — check before you finish the story: if the trigger turns out to be a one-time encounter, a manual save per chapter is the safe habit.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact unlock method is not confirmed yet by the published guides. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be about kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by from a bike. Until that is verified, the practical advice is to try melee attacks on nearby enemies while riding a motorcycle, and to check the PowerPyx guide for updates rather than grinding an unconfirmed method.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed — check before you finish the story: if it needs a specific vehicle or moment, a chapter-start save is the safe habit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip. This comes naturally from the robbery work for 100% completion; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but those only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; marked bills keep coming from robberies after the story.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative, not one purchase. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation (24 stores), car mods at mod shops (14), and tattoos (11 studios). Clothing (67 stores), footwear (17), hair and beauty salons (18) and electronics (15) all count too. If you are already buying gear for other trophies, this pops on its own; otherwise a few big gun and mod purchases close it out quickly.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; shops stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through that app. All 8 cost $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3 and 4. Buying garages also adds parking spots, which you need for the Scooter Bros trophy.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; garages stay buyable after the story.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garage space — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable; vehicles can be registered any time after Chapter 2.
trophies.name: On the Spot
